reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.access_rule: Retrieved is not read. Complete-page labels describe substantive page text, not every linked work. Local PDF downloads are working material, excluded from publication payload. Provider references and observed URLs locate actual events; raw response archive preserves unsuccessful routes.
